table.name: TLGNC_RAILWAY_STATION
table.description: Railway stations used by Crh. Contains both operational and commercial stations. the Railway station is operational if it is assigned to a shippingpoint/shipto.

column.name: UIC_COUNTRY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnc_uic_country. UIC country code of the railway station.

column.name: RAILWAY_STATION_NO
column.description: 6-digit Railway Station no. may contain leeding zeros. UIC_country_cd + railway_station_no is an alternative identifier for a railway station.

column.name: RAILWAY_STATION_NAME
column.description: Name of the railway station as officially used by the railway company.
